text:
liz: Quick heads-up — ran a scoped RBAC audit and found the service-account 'ingest-embeddings' has chat:generate/chat.stream scopes. Looks like the role-refactor PR accidentally granted a legacy wildcard.
security-bot: ALERT: policy-change detected for role=ingest-embeddings by infra-bot at 2026-03-12T13:45:08Z :rotating_light:

tom: which PR? link pls
liz: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4252 — the change collapsed several route-specific roles into one.

ben: repro steps: use an embeddings token issued to that SA, call chat.generate -> succeeds. sample auth log entry:
```
2026-03-12T13:52:14Z auth=token:ingest-embeddings action=chat.generate result=allow via role=routes:*
```

carol: that role should've been routes:embeddings.create only. The RoleBinding ended up with routes:* from the consolidation script.

tom: is this related to yesterday's KMS rewrap? i saw a rekey event ~2h earlier.
liz: KMS rewrap happened but commit author for the policy change is infra-bot (pr merged around same time). no clear causal link yet.

ben: impact: internal ingestion pipeline could call chat models (data exposure risk). no public/external tokens seen so far. mitigation: revoke the SA token, re-issue with minimal scopes, and revert the refactor until we add lints.
sre-oncall: rolling back PR now, pausing ingestion pipeline, and rotating the SA token. will post updates.

carol: we also need an audit backfill — some auth events lack key-id/tag because of the rewrap timing. need to correlate KMS events with auth logs.
liz: filing a vuln/incident: VULN-2026-1123 / INC-2026-0312-17. assigned to sec-response + infra. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/VULN-2026-1123

tom: proposed action items:
1) revoke and rotate the service-account token (sre)
2) revert the role-refactor PR and pin roles explicitly (eng-infra)
3) KMS audit: confirm rewrap metadata preserved, tag missing entries (sec+infra)
4) add policy-linter to CI to block wildcard/cluster-bindings in route refactors (devex) — I'll own this.

ben: temporary rule: block chat.generate from ingest-embeddings via authz firewall until rotation done.
security-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-0312-17 assigned to @sec-response :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: update 13:58Z — PR reverted, token rotated, ingestion pipeline paused. collecting auth logs and policy diffs.

liz: please attach artifacts to the ticket: policy diff, auth logs snippet, KMS rewrap event IDs, and the merged PR sha.

tom: will open a follow-up PR adding a unit test + linter rule preventing non-explicit route globs (example failure message included).

carol: set postmortem required. initial severity = sev3 unless we find evidence of exfiltration.

ben: quick scan shows no outgoing network calls to third-party endpoints from that SA in the last 6h.

liz: great — for now we contain. will keep the thread updated as artifacts come in. reopen if we find further exposure. :thumbsup:
